predecessors.name: Chenla
predecessors.text: the northern half of the divided Chenla, 'located in Isan (northeast Thailand)'

successors.name: Khmer Empire
successors.text: the northern lands: 'Land Chenla maintained its integrity under Jayavarman II, who proclaimed the Khmer Empire in 802'

capitals.name: Mueang Fa Daet Song Yang (Kalasin), outer capital of Wendan

ledger.x: c. 707: Chenla splits and Land Chenla (Wendan) forms in the north. 'shortly after 706, the country was split into Land Chenla and Water Chenla' (New Book of Tang), after 6 February 707 by the Tang histories; 'Land Chenla is located in Isan (northeast Thailand)'.
802: Land Chenla passes into the Khmer Empire.

wars.name: Mai Thuc Loan's rebellion (722-723)
wars.outcome: The page records only that Land Chenla's embassy of 722-723 'aided' the rebellion; the result and any change of border are not on it.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a frontier; the Isan outline and its Mekong and Champa edges are approximate.
